statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. A delayed NQ reopen quote is modestly positive after Tuesday’s weaker cash close, while the 10-year yield remains near 5% and Brent remains above $108. Direct live pullback and failed-retracement structure is not verified, so Tail remains low while Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH at the assessment cutoff. Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC data, 13:30 UTC cash open, and 18:00/18:30 UTC FOMC sequence are the principal conditional checkpoints.
headline: Tail remains low before Wednesday’s event stack while oil and yields keep Stress extreme
body: Tuesday closed with weaker U.S. equities, elevated Treasury yields and oil above $108. The reopened December NQ contract is only modestly positive on delayed data, which does not establish current retracement quality or a persistent one-way path. The FOMC remains the main multi-stage forward risk window.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 18% to 23%. It moved into WATCH through parts of Tuesday’s premarket and U.S. session, peaked at 23% in power hour, and returned to low after the cash close while Stress rose from the high 80s to extreme.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because available post-close evidence does not verify persistent one-way NQ structure. Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC data and 13:30 UTC cash open are conditional checkpoints; the 18:00/18:30 UTC FOMC sequence is the principal multi-stage danger window, with future Tail capped at WATCH absent observed mean-reversion failure.

forecast.analysis: A delayed NQ quote at 18:43 ET showed 29,282.75 (+0.12%) after Tuesday’s weaker cash close; 10-year yield and Brent remained near 4.99% and $108.5. The quote is contextual, not proof of intrahour retracement quality, and no persistent one-way NQ path is verified.
drivers: Delayed NQ reopen is only modestly positive

news.title: Wall Street ends lower as oil spikes and the benchmark Treasury yield breaches 5%
US energy chief says Saudi Arabia oil pipeline should be back online within days

forecast.analysis: Late U.S. evening remains low Tail if reopened futures continue two-sided trade. A sustained directional break with shallow pullbacks would be the first path-based reason to move toward WATCH; elevated oil and rates mainly preserve Stress.
drivers: Two-sided futures-reopen trade remains the baseline
Oil and rates mainly sustain Stress

forecast.analysis: Around 01:00 UTC, low Tail assumes ordinary counter-moves remain available. Repeated extension after failed retracements would invalidate that baseline, while high oil and yields alone do not establish a pathological NQ path.
drivers: Failed retracements are the escalation checkpoint
High oil and yields need NQ path confirmation

forecast.analysis: Early Asia remains low Tail if overnight price discovery rotates rather than extends. Holding near an overnight extreme while repeatedly rejecting counter-moves would be the clearest conditional reason for escalation.

Asia-session Tail stays low under balanced trade. Fresh geopolitical or energy headlines would primarily keep Stress extreme unless they generate sustained directional NQ follow-through with weak retracements.
drivers: Sustained NQ follow-through required for higher Tail

forecast.analysis: Overnight conditions remain low Tail if momentum fades between impulses. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks, rather than headline intensity alone, would be the key contrary evidence.
drivers: Headline intensity alone does not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: Ahead of Europe, Tail remains low if the overnight range continues absorbing moves in both directions. A one-way range expansion with shallow retracements would be the main invalidation.
European pre-open trade remains low Tail if overnight moves continue to retrace. A persistent cross-session directional break with little counter-movement would be the main reason to lift risk.

The European cash-open hour modestly raises path risk. Tail stays low if opening volatility produces meaningful counter-moves; continuation through the handoff with little retracement would push the state toward WATCH.

European morning remains below WATCH if directional impulses are retraced. Alignment between NQ, yields and oil would matter more only if price begins holding near an extreme and failed counter-moves accumulate.

Late European morning remains low Tail if the market rotates rather than trends efficiently. Persistent extension into the U.S. premarket would raise concern, especially if yields or oil reinforce the same direction.
drivers: Yields and oil as secondary amplifiers

forecast.analysis: Approaching the U.S. premarket, Tail remains low while no major U.S. release has printed. A pre-data trend with shallow pullbacks could lift risk, but hypothetical post-release alignment is not treated as observed evidence.
drivers: Future release outcomes are not pre-counted

forecast.analysis: The hour before the 12:30 UTC data window carries very high Stress but still-low Tail. Event importance alone does not imply mean-reversion failure; only an already-emerging one-way pre-release path would change that.
drivers: Retail Sales and import/export prices approach
Pre-release path matters more than event importance
Tail remains below WATCH without persistence

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 12:30 UTC Retail Sales and Import/Export Price releases. WATCH reflects conditional event-path risk; orderly two-sided price discovery and meaningful retracements would argue for rapid de-escalation.

The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open follows the macro releases. Tail is at the top of WATCH conditionally; shallow pullbacks, repeated extension and session-extreme holding would be the evidence required for escalation.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks plus extension would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The first full cash-session hour remains WATCH while the market digests the data and opening move. Meaningful retracement or mixed breadth would reduce Tail; failed rebounds and repeated extension would preserve path risk.

Mid-morning Tail eases if the opening impulse has produced counter-moves and cross-asset signals are mixed. Continued one-way extension would keep WATCH in force, but generic volatility alone does not justify a higher band.
drivers: Generic volatility does not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: Late morning remains WATCH because the FOMC is still ahead. Tail would stay contained if NQ rotates normally; if oil/rates remain stressed and a directional pre-Fed build develops with weak pullbacks, concern would increase.
drivers: Weak-pullback pre-Fed trend is the escalation checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The principal danger window begins near 17:45 UTC. Pre-FOMC Tail is WATCH, not a block, because the decision has not yet printed; a strongly aligned one-way move before 18:00 UTC would be the condition for further escalation.
drivers: Pre-decision one-way alignment would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The 18:00 UTC FOMC decision and 18:30 UTC press conference make this the highest conditional risk hour. WATCH remains capped below blocking absent observed persistent extension; statement, Q&A and rates reaction can create multiple information waves.
drivers: Multi-stage rates and equity repricing risk

forecast.analysis: The immediate post-Q&A phase can generate a second directional leg. Tail stays at the top of WATCH conditionally; failed retracements, repeated extension and aligned yields would be the evidence needed for a higher state.
drivers: Yield alignment can amplify a persistent path

forecast.analysis: The delayed post-FOMC repricing window remains a special checkpoint. A clean return to two-sided trade would lower Tail quickly, while a persistent second leg with shallow pullbacks would sustain or increase risk.
drivers: Persistent shallow-pullback second leg would raise concern

forecast.analysis: Later U.S. trade remains WATCH while any delayed FOMC repricing is assessed. Tail should ease if volatility decays and meaningful retracements return; continued extreme holding would keep path risk elevated.
drivers: Extreme holding would keep WATCH active

forecast.analysis: After the main FOMC danger window, residual WATCH remains conditional on unresolved repricing. Ordinary retracements and cross-asset stabilization would lower Tail further; continued one-way extension would keep risk elevated.
drivers: Cross-asset stabilization is a de-escalation signal

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence shows only a modest delayed NQ reopen; direct retracement quality is unverified, so Tail remains low despite extreme macro Stress.
Low Tail persists conditionally if reopened futures remain two-sided; shallow-pullback directional continuation would move risk toward WATCH.
Ordinary counter-moves keep Tail low; repeated extension after failed retracements would invalidate the baseline.
Early-Asia risk remains low if price rotates; persistent extreme holding with rejected counter-moves would be the escalation signal.
Balanced Asia trade keeps Tail low; geopolitical or energy headlines matter for Tail only if NQ develops sustained weak-retracement follow-through.
Low Tail persists if overnight momentum fades between impulses; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be contrary evidence.
